name: search_payamgostar
description: Search the PayamGostar CRM knowledge base (official help center up to v2.8.8.2, release notes, capability catalog, team-verified RFI answers, gaps, technical/security, installation, integrations). Returns ranked evidence snippets with source file and article title. Results are leads: read the cited article before claiming a capability. Query in Persian or English.

query.description: Question or requirement text, e.g. 'ورود دومرحله‌ای پیامکی' or 'two-way sync with Sepidar invoices'

only.description: Optional: 'kb' = official help center only, 'ref' = curated reference files only

x-implementation: python3 skills/payamgostar-knowledge/scripts/find.py "<query>" --top <top> [--only <only>] --json   (or: import find; find.search(query, top, only))
